audit.status: Historical execution record, measured before the infrastructure-failure and stop-on-policy-block corrections.
audit.reason: The original classifier mixed process-start failures with program failures. Full per-run infrastructure flags were not exported. These rates are withdrawn; no replacement numbers are inferred.
audit.followup_evidence: A later integration run recorded Windows error 4551: An Application Control policy has blocked this file. Subsequent code stops a campaign, job and comparison on that denial.
audit.limitations: Scripted inference, native Windows, no supported ThreadSanitizer, one baseline run per fixture. This is not a model-quality or cost-savings study.
